<!-- codex-review-on-assign -->
- [P1 blocking] Preserve destination edits when the pending env file is deleted — `src/utils/git.ts:1400`: A pending deletion (`git rm env/env.yaml`) fails the `entry.present` check, bypassing conflict detection. If the destination added `COLLEAGUE_KEY`, `restoreWorkingTree` then deletes its env file without refusing the push. Handle deletion as a merge/conflict case so destination-only data is not lost.
- The PR description includes a representative real-CLI world verification record; the testing-record requirement is satisfied. No PR code was executed.

Independently reproduced the bot's deletion finding on head `55a59c8e`, using native Windows, Node 24.11.0, and the existing team-ref test fixture with a local bare Git remote.

1. Commit `env/env.yaml` with `BASE_KEY` on main.
2. Push `review/delete-env` with an additional `COLLEAGUE_KEY`.
3. Return to main and run `git rm env/env.yaml`.
4. Call `prepareExplicitBranch(localPath, 'review/delete-env')`, then `pushRepoBranch` for that file and branch.

Branch preparation returned without refusing the conflict, switched to `review/delete-env`, and left the env file deleted. Publication returned `true`; `git ls-tree origin/review/delete-env -- env/env.yaml` then returned no entry. This removes the whole destination env file, including the destination-only key.

The existing three env-conflict/carry tests pass. A regression expecting this delete-versus-edit conflict to be refused fails. I am preparing a focused fix and regression for you to cherry-pick.

@pcbeingused333 The deletion-conflict fix is ready in [dd99bb04](https://github.com/STiFLeR7/teamai-cli/commit/dd99bb04680827572ac229ccf943be437d5baa59), based directly on this PR's current head, `55a59c8e`. Could you cherry-pick it onto your branch?

It refuses a pending shared-file deletion when the destination changed that file, restores the source branch with the pending deletion preserved, and allows deletions when the destination is unchanged or already deleted the file.

Four deletion cases pass, covering staged/unstaged conflicts and both safe cases. The team-ref and YAML suites passed 81 tests, with three skipped, using process-local `core.autocrlf=false`. Build, typecheck, targeted lint, and whitespace checks passed on Windows. The CLI-world harness reports Windows as unsupported, so I could not run that verification here.

```sh
git fetch https://github.com/STiFLeR7/teamai-cli.git fix/1912-env-deletion-conflict
git cherry-pick dd99bb04680827572ac229ccf943be437d5baa59
```

Thanks @STiFLeR7, I replaced my commit with a cherry-pick of your dd99bb04 ("fix(push): refuse conflicting shared-file deletions"), keeping your authorship. It covers the staged/unstaged conflict and the two safe cases (unchanged/deleted) with tests, which is more complete than my version (my test also built its ref in an odd way via `.replace(/^/, 'origin/')`). `team-ref.test.ts` passes on the updated branch.

This reply was drafted with the assistance of an AI coding tool (Claude Code); the change itself is the reviewer's commit.

<!-- codex-review-on-assign -->
No new findings in the current diff.

- **Resolved:** The earlier pending-deletion finding is fixed: deletions now refuse destination changes, with tests covering staged and unstaged deletions.
- **Testing record:** The PR description includes a representative real-CLI world run, satisfying the requirement. Its older build identifier is not blocking under the review rules.
- Reviewed only the specified diff; no PR code was run, built, or installed.
